reviews.t: Gets rid of dandruff and so relaxing!

The silicone bristles are flexible and gentle on the scalp but still gives a great deep cleanse. This is the only product that has helped get rid of my dandruff that I struggled with for years! Dandruff shampoos have never helped. It’s the gentle mechanical friction with this brush that keeps your scalp clean and healthy. Feels so

And it works like a charm 😊 I'm definitely a scrubber and have a ton of joint pain especially in my fingers and this was definitely a game changer for me. Leaves your scalp feeling squeaky clean and well massaged.  I find I get a lot of dandruff and build up and itchy scalp when I'm on chemotherapy and this has really helped offset it. Bought this expecting it to work really well based on the reviews, but I don't think it worked at all, and I've had it for about a month and a half using regularly.

Wow what an amazing massager. The bristle are hard silucine. Stimulate my scalp very well and for the price its even better. I saw a video on scalp massage and says to do it with this for 4 minutes  everyday to stimulate circulation and promote hair growth.
Love this! Haven’t had it long enough to know if it helps my hair grow, but it’s wonderful as a scalp massager and even helps fluff my hair for styling! Thanks!

My itchy scalp has gotten better since I started using this, so it's definitely improved my scalp health which in turn improves hair health. Healthy scalp = healthy hair. reviews.t: Soft, clean, massage feeling, life changing
reviews.x: I order this product as something cheap just to get free shipping, but when I tell you how amazing it actually is. I have never been so happy to buy such a random product. It is literally amazing. I’m only 16, but I love the feeling of a massage while I’m washing my hair. Another thing is that it looks like it would hurt or not be too flexible but it’s honestly pretty soft and feels so good. I really feel like my scalp is getting clean when I use this product!!! 💕

Its sturdy, and soft at the same time. I do the CGM and i only use conditioner, this gadget really helps with giving my scalp a good massage/scrub. I have long hair and it gets through with no trouble. There was absolutely no smell coming from it when I opened it. I have been using it for 3 weeks and it has holded up pretty good. I was afraid that by using it under the shower, water would collect inside of it but that has not been a problem. Definitely recommend

I love this product!!  It works so well and feels so good for the humans in the household I am ordering another ome to use for our 2 fur babies!!  I am however very sadden by the fact that someone in the UPS system felt it was ok to cut open the 1st delivery of this product and remove it from the package!!  This is theft no matter the value of the item!!  Watch items being mailed through UPS!  Thank you Amazon for sending the replacement quickly!!

After 3 months of use, I can say this massages the scalp well. I have used it after oil application and while hair wash. I used it for my 3 yr old daughter as well.. I have seen people use this for their pet dogs to clean them during bath. I would definitely recommend this product. The seller packed it well and the package was shipped promptly. Very glad I made this purchase. My sister also bought this after I recommended her.

reviews.t: Best addition to scalp care routine
reviews.x: I’ve tried countless shampoos and products to help manage a flaky scalp and can’t believe this inexpensive little scalp massager is what did it for me. I use it to gently massage my scalp and have almost entirely eradicated my scalp itching/flaking. I don’t even bother with sticking with the expensive scalp treatment shampoos anything, this was a life saver and so worth it!

This little massager is the best scalp massage I have ever had. I use it since my hair is thinning to add serums to my scalp and get the blood flowing. I love how soft it is never gets tangled in my hair and my hair is pretty long. Thin, but long...It gives off such relaxation and hits the nerves perfect to give off even tingles all over.

i honestly have no idea where i first heard about this but i’m glad i ended up getting it. this has changed my hair game so much and made my hair feel wayyy better. it’s super easy to use and hold and it’s super gentle too. i think everyone need this for your hair because it honestly helps so much. (unless your bald)

reviews.t: Must have! Purchase it and thank me later.
reviews.x: I loveee my shampoo brush! If you haven't already purchased one you need this is in your life. Not only was it beautiful with vibrant colors but felt amazing and had a very nice grip making it easy to hold. It's wonderful for the scalp and a product saver. Seriously, you need to purchase one. Thank me later!

Probably the best thing I've ever gotten on Amazon dollar for dollar. Seriously this thing is awesome I've been doing it wrong for 25 years of my life. This is just absolutely perfect and it's really cheap don't spend an extra dime on any of the other ones this is all you will need.

I bought this wanting to use it when I washed my hair, but it doesn't work on wet hair. The silicone...spikes?...they're not bristles, so I'm not sure what to call them...don't glide through wet hair. The hair sticks to them and they just pull your hair. Glad I'm only out $4...

Bought this to help remove the build up in my hair. Works great!! Easy to hold, bristles are soft and does not tangle my hair. Absolutely worth the little bit it costs. I use it when i shampoo and when i conditioner. The build up is very minimal now and scalp feels so clean!

reviews.t: Get the one with longer bristles
reviews.x: The bristles are a bit short to get to my scalp. I have thick straight hair and I can just vertically brush my scalp from hairline to about 3 inches back. The rest of my hair is too thick. I can section the rest of my hair to brush the scalp but it gets easily tangled.

I love these scalp massagers, specifically this shape/model. These are super easy to hold on to even with soapy hands. The massagers are not super stiff, but they're also not super soft. It's a perfect happy medium and both my son and I love these.

Great product for the scalp.  I tend to scratch my head during washing and this massager does the trick. It is hard enough to massage my head, but not too hard that my head is sore.  I will purchase a few more for stocking stuffers this Christmas.

reviews.t: Works well, has lasted over a year and is still in good condition
reviews.x: This does what it says. I’ve had no issues with it. It seems pretty hardy, having survived over a year of use + being dropped occasionally. the silicone is fairly rigid which lets it massage your head a bit better. Easy to grip while wet.

This product is great! The silicone is strong enough to give you a good scrub, but soft enough to be gentle on the scalp. I chose this brush because it was the cheapest, and I see no reason to spend more for a similar product. Great buy!

Great item. Works perfectly and the silicone is gentle enough to not hurt my scalp but strong enough to give me a good scalp scrub. (I had a massive  craniotomy and have a rather large scar on my skull that can be tender at times.$

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the massager as relaxing and effective for scalp massage and deep cleansing.
Many reviewers report it helps with dandruff, flaking, and itchy scalp.
Reviewers commonly highlight the excellent value and low price.
Several reviewers note the bristles are soft and gentle while still effective, and don't tangle in long hair.
A few reviewers mention using it on pets, while one reviewer felt it did not work at all.
